summary: Final architectural plan and implementation specification for School AI V0.1, fully incorporating the micro-correction pass: complete removal of hardcoded model IDs in favor of deployment configuration capabilities, pgvector extension and vector column type with HNSW index strategy, cryptographically hardened challenge-hash confirmation token storage, controlled explicit Google Calendar sync for V0.1, cleaned artifact sector enums (document, spreadsheet, presentation, email), multi-factor policy-based authorization replacing numerical hierarchies, defense-in-depth security model with mandatory backend authorization, full knowledge retrieval provenance tracking, and an audited 13-phase build order.
